description: Source code for ESP32 pulse counter driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, interrupt handling, and sensor API implementation.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches pulse count data for all units or rotation channel.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current count value or rotation count.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_configure_pinctrl
methods.description: Applies pin configuration for the device.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_init
methods.description: Initializes the pulse counter device, sets up clock, pinctrl, and count units.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_attr_set_thresh
methods.description: Sets threshold values for low and high limits.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_attr_set
methods.description: Sets various sensor attributes like thresholds and offset.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for pulse counter events, calls trigger handler if set.

methods.name: pcnt_esp32_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures threshold-based triggers and registers ISR.
